neighbours.label: 'All' or 'Any' opening a new sentence or line as a quantifier over things just discussed ('All of these factors...', 'All children must...'), as against 'all' inside a sentence and sentences opening with another determiner
fire:
The museum reopened in May.
All visitors must now book a ticket online.

The inspectors checked every school in the region.
All of them passed the fire safety test.
Several brands of paint were compared. All of these contained lead.
We moved house twice that year. Any spare money went on the rent.

The rules changed in January.
All drivers have to carry their licence.
Four wells were dug in the village. All of them dried up by August.

The recipe uses butter, honey and oats.
Any of these can be swapped for cheaper ones.
Three bridges were built in the valley. All were designed by one engineer.
